title: SREV-056 file delete path tree buffer boundary contract

path_node.description: PATH_NODE component appended during recursive serialization

translated_path.description: Allocated DOS-style path returned by File_TranslateNtToDosPathForDatFile

contracts: The path tree serializer owns a fixed 0x7FFF + 1 WCHAR buffer
A recursive slash append is legal only when Length + 1 is below PathCapacity
A child component append is legal only when the component plus NUL fits in PathCapacity
The path buffer allocation must be checked before recursion
Translation requires a non-null non-empty NUL-terminated NtPath
The DOS path allocation must be checked before wcscpy, wcschr, or wmemmove
